title: A Happy Little Orgasm (Naked & Natural)
description: Hi, I’m Shibby. I’d like to welcome you to the happy world of painting, using your imagination. Imagination is like any muscle in your body. The more you practice, the better you become. In today's session I have so many experimental techniques I’d like to show you. All you need is a happy little heart and a willing mind. Life is all about creating happy little places. Come join me on a painting adventure, together. Step into the canvas with me. I will start off by showing you some simple ways to paint a beautiful, calming nature scene- and for those of you adventurous enough to make it inside my cabin, a sexy surprise awaits!
author: Mistress Shibby
